ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious CodePage Switch Via CHCP
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a code page switch in command line or batch scripts to a rare language

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\chcp\\\.com$") AND (process_command_line = RGX("\\ 936$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\ 1258$")))
